description: Reviewed gates that execute tests aimed at a foundation package, other than check-foundation-behaviour.py whose suites are read from the script itself. kind: U executes retained upstream material, P executes only project-authored tests or fixtures, F is a companion proc-macro whose expansion an executed suite exercises, I only compiles or links the package for another package's tests and never counts as executed.
